exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
outcome: Mean concentration of IL-6 in amniotic fluid
cohort: 47 women with term pregnancies who had spontaneous rupture of membranes during labour
finding: The mean concentration of IL-6 in the amniotic fluid was significantly higher in the vaginal delivery group compared to the caesarean section group.
mod_finding: The mean value of IL-6 concentration from the amniotic fluid collected from the vagina immediately after rupture of membranes was significantly higher in patients who had a successful vaginal delivery than those who did not.
